knowledge: Existing v2 data, prior composition package and all published Codex followup results are already known. No stage is called external blind validation. New exact teams and cores are not new independent workers, images or buildings.

split.history_role: Fit all worker features and replacement-risk categories; inner building-separated CV may select/compare training representations.
split.discovery_role: Explore actual category-block replacements, quality, geometry, efficiency and conditional supports; retain the entire candidate ledger.
split.assessment_role: Freeze labels, comparisons and exact new seeded requests before computing this round's assessment results. Same previously explored v2 assessment buildings; conditional replication only.

forward: History-only interpretable Q, low-tail, variability, T, difficulty, structural habits, source-specific Semi and error-nonedit evidence, scope tendency and adjudicated correctness where actually available. Missing opportunities remain unknown. Full labels are descriptive only.
reverse: Multi-image multi-core actual fusion-replacement relationships must enter category learning and selection. Old history exact-core events plus metadata-only additional n contexts. Mean Q prediction is not the learning objective. Capacity and unknown pair supports explicit.
block_primary_unit: Exact class-count vector plus total n and task condition. Paired A/B/C: identical core, n, actual replaced block size m; A/B replace disjoint members with unchanged composition; C changes a named class block or multiple named classes. Different core or proportions are separate registered contexts.
outside_fine_group: For high-Q or other supported fine domains, workers outside that domain may form an explicitly identified fixed background. They are not assigned a fabricated class and are not evidence of fine-class capacity.
metrics: Preserve old strict/main/wide and no-Q decompositions. Additional pre-batch shape contract in independent/METRIC_CONTRACT.json, including redundant point sensitivity, floor, walls, corners, ERP boundaries and height/prism diagnostics. No new mixed success score.
analysis: Report exact named class directions and count vectors; building-balanced summaries and image/building/worker/unique-team support; within-class bad tail and failures; signed B8L2/D10 changes; no zero imputation. Overall signal first, then Q/source/individual controls separately. Efficiency remains independent value, with actual time availability and source semantics.
search: Systematic finite candidate and feasible n/m coverage where affordable; seeded stratified designs otherwise. Log actual coverage, capacity exclusions, untested combinations, failed candidates and counterexamples. Never describe sampled concrete teams as exhaustive enumeration.
scope_attachment: Local supplied scope discussion read as a proposal and interpretive boundary, not adopted new GT, scope adjudication, or qualification. Existing reference and OOS rules remain fixed.
delivery: Lean source, frozen per-worker labels, exact requests, small evidence tables, figures, selected final geometries and native replays from final directory. No full inputs, intermediate native states, distance matrices, model caches or original image archive.
